notes: v1.4: Client-PC install now installs ALL prerequisites automatically. Setup.bat installs Python 3.12 if missing (winget, else python.org, no admin, Store stub ignored), checks tkinter + sqlite3, installs openpyxl from the bundled wheels folder (works offline, falls back to online pip), runs an app self-check (python app.py --check), then creates the data folders and desktop shortcut. Includes v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window) and v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
